name: l3-ja-reading-accuracy
metric: per-item phoneme-sequence equality after punctuation stripping (docs/evaluation.md §3)
frontend: sbv2 ja frontend (num2word → normalize → g2p), no model bundle needed

without_dictionary.note: JaNormalizer closed 6 of 8 gap items; month euphony items (4月/7月/9月 → シガツ/シチガツ/クガツ) added from user listening feedback and now gate-enforced

gap_worklist: latin-letters: coined Latin words read letter-by-letter — CLOSED by the M3 dictionary layer (use --dict; built-in expansion of arbitrary coinages is out of scope by design)
CLOSED by JaNormalizer (2026-09-13): minus-sign, date-compound x2, colon-time, currency-symbol, percent-symbol, unit-letter
notes: Comparison happens at the phoneme level (mora-split both sides), so spelling variants that sound identical (ジュウ/ジュー) are equal.
Gap items are annotated with the gap field; when a fix lands, the item flips to passing and the gap field is dropped in the same PR.
The worklist is the M3+ normalization roadmap: symbol expansion (%/¥/単位) and date/time context reading are next; the dictionary layer covers coined words and user vocabulary.
After JaNormalizer: 21/22 without dict, 22/22 with the fixture dict; the only open item is the dictionary-owned latin-letters case.

2026-09-13 user listening feedback: 9月 must be くがつ (not きゅうがつ), 4月 → しがつ, 7月 → しちがつ aligned per user decision (なながつ available via user dictionary). Katakana rewrites survive NJD kansuji preprocessing (a written しち gets remapped to なな by NJD — measured).
